name: aegisocean
description: AegisOcean — AI-Powered Maritime Oil Spill Detection, Vessel Attribution & Blockchain Evidence Anchoring

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --prefix "[{name}]" --names "ML,BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "magenta,blue,cyan" "npm run dev:ml" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --prefix "[{name}]" --names "BLOCKCHAIN,ML,BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "yellow,magenta,blue,cyan" "npm run dev:blockchain" "npm run dev:ml" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../Frontend && npm install && cd ../AegisOcean-repo/blockchain && npm install
scripts.typecheck: cd backend && npm run typecheck && cd ../Frontend && npx tsc -b

author: AegisOcean Team
